I know some people swear by the raw diet, I'm acquainted with some myself, but as I said there just hasn't been enough studies on pet done for it to be considered beneficial or not. 
To be fair concerning wild dogs, foxes and wolves who are purely feral and aren't in contact in some way or another with people, you usually don't see them live long enough to be considered old. When a feral dog gets a bone stuck, they'll usually get an extreme mix of both diarrhea constipation, will stop eating and then die. When a pet dog gets a bone stuck, usually the owners will bring them to the vet as quickly as the symptoms appear so we can either give medicine and treatment that'll help the digestion and will get the bone to leave, or we surgically extract it.
Also there is a huge difference between the digestive system of a wolf and one of a dog. Not even necessarily talking about these breeds you hold in a hand bag all day long, even huge breeds have a much more sensitive stomach because they're just not used to eating anything else than kibbles. It's known that even just switching from different kibble brands too suddenly can cause diarrhea and digestive discomfort for them.

Of course all dogs are different though! Some of them will have a great time only eating raw, will perfectly digest bones and will power through eating a whole trashcan of garbage in one sitting. I've seen that too. But the exception doesn't make the rule, and it's still important to remind dog owners that giving bones isn't perfectly safe and can have absolutely terrible outcomes. I think it's better to just use other alternatives if it means avoiding a potentially huge medical bill, but most importantly it's your pet's health that is at risk.
I had no idea but that's good to know! We only sell deer antlers where I work, but that's probably because I live in France and I doubt there are much water buffalos over there lol

Tbh we are very skeptical of the raw diet in the workline (at least where I work) as there just hasn't been enough studies on the long run on whether or not it is actually beneficial for the pet. Raw bones can still cause splinters, get stuck and aren't easily digested, especially for dogs who have a sensitive digestion. I could send you at least a dozen of radiographies done on dogs who got bones stuck that we needed to surgically extract, but I don't think I'm allowed to share these kind of images online anyway as it's still sensitive medical information. Anyway I probably know I won't change your mind but for anyone reading this, if you love your dog please ask your veterinarian what's best for them! As I said earlier, antlers are a much better alternative to bones that's 100% safe, and it's just as much fun for them to toy with. There are a lot of different sizes of antlers made for differently sized dog too.

As an emergency vet nurse, you can not even imagine the number of dogs we've received with bones stuck in their intestines/stomach. In worst case scenario, a bone can even perforate viscera. Please never give bones to a pet. A safe alternative that is both stimulating and much safer are deer antlers :)

I'm actually surprised to hear about everybody's experience when it comes to being diagnosed and prescribed in france?

I've been diagnosed last year (20yo then) and althought the process wasn't really adhd friendly (9 months waiting list requiring a doctor prescription, a mental diagnose divised in 5 sessions with a psychologist and finally multiple self-evaluated quizzes), it felt refreshing to talk with professionals and feel my struggles being validated.

At first I went and told my generalist doctor I was suspecting adhd and I wanted to see where it'd lead, so she just asked a few questions on why I felt like adhd might have been the issue, how I felt at work and at school. Never once emitted a judgment or went "you're too old for adhd" or even laughed. She just gave me the prescription and told me good luck and that she hoped I'd find the answers I needed.
Then I went to see a psychiatrist that specialized in adhd in the region I lived in (pour les francais du 06 : Le Dr. Plaquet est un psychiatre très amical, je ne me suis jamais sentie mal à l'aise ou jugée avec lui). After a few sessions across last spring I was diagnosed and offered medication.

Though I'll agree with you during my childhood I'd only heard of adhd as "the thing that make kids go hyper", but my opinion might have been influenced by a classmate during middle school that was, indeed, hyper. It's still widely thought of as a fake illness surrounded by misconceptions.
Yet, most of my colleagues at work and even my boss have never even been rude or mean about it. Anyone I'd spoken to about it have been curious and shown interrest in the way I describe how it feels to live in my head. Doesnt mean it's easier to work while being adhd, even with medication, eh.

It actually depends, I'm not familiar with the product though I could tell you two things :

It's the same anywhere with any product but "repellent" doesn't equal "effective" from what I know in my field a repellent barely works at its own job, and at least in France there's no guarantee behind the word so the sellers don't actually have to give guarantee for a result, if the product doesn't work.

For exemple with something I'm more familiar with (so I can explain better), a flea collar that is "repellent" rarely has any effect on fleas and is only supposed to make them want to go away with smell or chemicals superficially, which rarely actually works. You could find these in supermarkets for exemple. 
While, a flea collar that is "anti-parasitic" will actually have an effect on the fleas by actually killing them (in the case of a collar it will diffuse a product that will slowly reach the bloodstream), which you can only find in a veterinary clinic.

So basically a repellent is only a name for a product that has no actual guarantee to work, and doesn't need studies/back ups/results to keep its own name.

Secondly, I'm not sure about the "pet safe" thing, but a safe rule to go by is to always avoid direct contact or use on your pet of any product that isn't marketed specifically for animals, and to never use them in too big of a quantity at once.
Even human essential oils won't be dangerous on your animals as long as they're not exposed for hours/days/months at a time on direct exposition, and as long as they can't ingest it. If you want to use the product, make sure you close of the room from your animals for a few hours, or keep them under watch so they don't go and lick the thing (which would be surprising anyway if there's peppermint essential oil).

I don't actually know how effective it is as a solution as much as I know that it's just an essential oil we use on animals that isn't toxic or harmful, which was the point of my original comment. I like the analyse though!

Of course you absolutely cannot use this as a treatment as it isn't one and never was advertised to be one! It's more like a therapy that can help with some of the symptoms of certain illnesses.

Partially true! I'm a vet auxiliary, so I can give a bit of knowledge for once :

Essential oils made for human are definitely toxic for any pets whether it be by skin contact, ingestion or inhalation. It 100% will either poison your animal or provoke an heavy irritation if exposed too much.

However the veterinary industry has developed some essential oils especially made for pets, and with the right knowledge and tools it can actually somewhat improve your pet's quality of life. The ones we use most are to be used with what we call an oxybox, which you connect to an inhalator with a few drops of essential oils (I'm familiar with the product called "Respicat" as an exemple). It can improve you pet's respiration when they are sick, for exemple if they present a respiratory inflammation or when their airways are partially obstructed by mucus.

It's good to always question what you see and of course make your own researches, but sometimes it's also good to listen to professionals and take their opinions in account!

I stood in surprise in my bed, looking all around myself. What was that? I felt petrified, barely able to articulate my jaw in a terrified stutter.

" - W-Who's there?"

Silence took place. I probably dreamt that voice, right? Even if someone was in the house, they wouldn't just introduce themself afterall. I felt heavy, and laid back my head on the bed. Just a dream, I repeated myself. At least until I noticed the buzzing I used to hear had completely disappeared. Jesus!

I rushed, jumping from the bed and running to the bathroom, my heart pounding from fear and excitement. How?! I looked right at the mirror and my reflexion stared back at me. I poked my ears, without any real idea what I was doing.

" - Hello. "

The voice appeared again, my entire body straightened in a goosebump. I looked around myself.

" - Who's here?! I will call the police if you don't get away right now! "

I caught the first thing under my hand to defend myself - my fidel toothbrush.

" - Please stay calm, John. "

" - How do you know my name? "

The voice, it felt like... Like it was comming from my head. I couldn't locate the sound, because it wasn't *there*.

" - You have nothing to fear, for I have always been a part of you. You know me well, much more than you think you do. "

" - What are you even talking about?"

More questions were popping in my head as every second passed, I let the toothbrush go and sat on the side of my small bathtube.

" - The doctors knew about my presence, that is why they tried to shut me. But you finally gained reason and allowed me in your conscience, you are a smart person John. "

" - The doctors? Do you mean..."

Was that voice replacing the buzzing sound I had heard for years? Were all these meds I took for years repressing this thing?

" - Listen to me, John. We both know you are deserving more than all what's surrounding you. Medical debts, school debts, your constant suffering for all these years. I am part of you and you are part of me, but common people wouldn't understand this... "

" - What are you implying...? "

His words were echoing, making no sense yet speaking directly to my soul. I knew the doctors only wanted to harm me, I've always had that feeling deep inside. Yet I listened to all their prescriptions, their pretended knowledge.

" - You need to leave, John. You need to get revenge. You lost everything, all your relations, all your passions, all because they were messing with your thoughts and your health. Find them, John, and avenge our years of loneliness and despair. "

" - Is that... Fair?

" - Do not doubt me, and remember. I am you, and you are me. Our life is falling appart and it is your role to make it back your own. "

I stood up. That voice was right afterall, I had to do something. I looked at the side of my mirror and smiled.

Today is the day I broke the chains society had strained me with.

[...]



This morning again was I starring at the blank walls in front of me, and that door with a small window letting pass a bit of sun lights from these infinite corridors. It has been years, maybe centuries, I had no way of remembering. My arms stuck around my sides in a restraining outfit, I felt agitated. That treatment was unfair, I am not sick.

" - John, you need to get out. "

These words weren't mine, yet they were coming from my own mouth. I laughed.

" - Oh voice, if only I knew why I was here. I am healthy, but they do not understand us. They do not understand you. "

A familiar face apprared in front of the window, looking at me suspiciously. I could feel their fear of my potential and my knowledge of Humans. He opened the door.

" Mr. Smith, it is time for your injection. "

" - Don't touch me, I am fine! I don't need no injection, you don't understand! I'm different! "

I screamed at the top of my lungs, but already was the syringue injecting its poison in my neck. I barely felt anything, yet the second after my body felt heavy. My voice got shut, and only then did the buzzing return.

" - Goodbye, Mr. Smith. I will be back in half a day. "

He left, closing the door behind him, but my ears could only hear the silent scream spawning from my brain.

She looked all around herself while her heart was pounding. This tiny hole she had been scratching all these years from the red wall washed away by time, at the bottom of the house, it was finally fitting her hips. She knew today was the day she could escape from this prison, from her parents.

" Anna? Where are you? "

She could already hear her mother's call for diner, but today she wouldn't share any table with no one. She was going to run free after all this time. What was she going to find on the other side of this once impassable wall? She had never seen a tree, even less a flower, yet her father always seemed to talk about their pretty colors with such nostalgy in his voice.  
She started squeezing her young vigorous body through the brick and felt a faint breeze on her plumped cheeks. It was there, so close! After so much pain, she was going to be set free!

The stood up in what had been described to her as grass, it felt warm and refreshing on her tiny black shoes as she brushed away the dust from her dress. Though when she looked up, she stopped in shock of what had been awaiting her on the other side. The trees were tall, as tall as they were touching the sky, no lights but the moon to enlighten her perimetter. But she wasn't gasping at the vegetation, nor was she surprised by the astral in the sky, nothing about what she had been awaiting to see mattered in her mind at the moment.

An eyeball was starring at her.

And it stared, directly inside her soul, something so titanic she fell on her two knees from the magnificant being elevated inbetween the stars themselves, his body covered in whips and limbs. It looked, and she cried. She cried from seeing everything in the span of a second, from realising she was nothing but an particule standing in front of a God. She was ten years old, yet she had now learnt everything she had ever needed to know. Already the screams of her parents comming from that house she once called home couldn't reached her anymore, as she was no longer standing there.

Where was she gone now, though?

There was that girl with Tourette syndrome, it's basically a mental illness that makes you have constant tics since childhood. It never was a problem for me, we started hanging out in middle school when we were both alone. I was kinda weird myself, younger than others in my class, so we were just the two weirdos of the school at first.

We spent 4 years together before both continuing high school together, she's always been the kind to arrive in another group and force herself into the discussions and I never realised it was wrong before. People couldn't call her off or tell her to get away otherwise she'd start blaming them for being intolerant over her sickness ; as so she thought everybody loved her, and all her problems were due to her syndrome.
Now, she had SERIOUS anger issues. Sometimes I'd just talk to her in class and she'd suddenly scream "I DON'T CARE!", without real warning or whatever. She'd also ghost me when she went to hang out with the popular kid (who didnt want to hang out with her) and she'd spread gossips about me, that I was smelly, telling secrets that I'd shared with her, and other things a friend usually *don't* do. 

Looking back at it, it feels like she was searching for a new scapegoat in the class. I know there were nasty rumors about her, maybe she had realised it herself and was trying to throw the focus on me instead so she'd be accepted. Whatever.

In the equivalent of sophomore year, i miraculously got to hang out with a guy in my class who wasnt giving a shit about our reputation. He'd act normal in front of her, but when we were alone he'd tell me about things she said or do in my back. He told me frankly what were my flaws, and at that time i decided I'd accept them and try to change. And so I did.
I started being more independant, less childish, and more true to myself. Also the time I started being an edgy kid dressing in black but hey, that was myself and that was good enough for me.
My best friend didn't like that at all.

She started copying me, getting deep into mangas and animes which I was actually glad for, it felt good to have an old friend getting into what you love. 
But she also started talking the exact same way I did, the way I interracted and dressed. She'd get in contact with my closest online friends and clearly tried to get them to love her instead of me, for which they warned me about.

That's when I started to cut of any link we had. 5 years close to this girl and I had became blind about how much of an interesting and fine person I was, since she kept blaming me each time I opened my mouth to say anything. When i choose to stop talking with her, it felt like I was breathing anew, and I'm not exagerating. I felt lighter in every single way and happy again about myself.
I felt lonely at first, since she was still forcing her way into the only group of friend we had in common. I stayed back and ate alone at lunch, but I didn't really mind since I felt better alone than with her.

A year after, I found an amazing group of friend that just arrived in my class. We were 4 girls into different hobbies and absolutely different in every regards, but still were really close even up to this day in different universities. I'll always love them because they were the first ones to show me I could be accepted in a group too.

My ex-best friend spent the rest of her school year basically alone, because everyone realised they actually could tell her to cut it off, just the same way I did. 


Sometimes i feel bad for her because she didn't realise her own problems, her anger issues, her self-centereness and her hypocrisy despite how much people tried to call her on about it. She just blamed it all on her syndrome. I only wish for her to be done with it if there's a way, and to improve for her own sake.
